mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy regime that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.35 million units signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which translates into higher corporate revenues and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1350.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and broadening economic slowdown, which triggers equity market repricing downward due to deteriorating corporate earnings outlook, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 102.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a synchronized surge in consumer demand for durable goods and shelter, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 313.0 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the interaction term Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 158500 and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the interaction term Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
